name: ChäoS;HEAd
description:
Takumi Nishijou, a high school student at the Private Suimei Academy, one day hears about the 'New Gen' murders that have been occurring around the city. Although dismissing the subject because it doesn't involve him, Takumi begins to experience strange mishaps around him, from a horrific picture he received while on his PC, to a mysterious Pink-Haired girl standing at a murder scene.

From there on Takumi struggles to cope with the events unfolding around him, and is soon unaware of what is real or a delusion. As his fate opens up before him, the perpetrator behind the 'New Gen' events attempts to find him, leading him into a world where nothing is as it seems.

episodes.name: Önyükleme
episodes.description: Takumi, iki boyutlu kızlar için bir fetiş olan, anime takıntılı bir münzevidir. Kirli küçük siber sırları, gizemli General ile bir sohbet odası karşılaşmasının ardından gerçek hayatta başını belaya sokar.

episodes.name: Benlik
episodes.description: Takumi, cinayet mahallindeki pembe saçlı kızı sınıfta yanında otururken bulduktan sonra aklını kaybediyor olabileceğinden korkuyor. İşleri daha da kötüleştirmek için, biri sürekli evini gözetliyor.

episodes.name: İletişim
episodes.description: Genç günlerinden bir trajediye ürpertici bir geri dönüş, Takumi'nin münzevi varlığına ışık tutuyor. Şimdiki zamanda, bir kahin sanatçısı tarafından verilen bir konsere katılıyor.

episodes.name: Başlıyor
episodes.description: Kılıç taşıyan genç kızların hayallerine musallat olan Takumi, kendi silahını aramaya başlar. Çılgınca arayışı, polisten istenmeyen bir ziyaretle karmaşıklaşıyor.

episodes.name: Rehberlik
episodes.description: Polis onu araştırmaya devam ederken, Takumi Ayase'den Di-Sword'un sırlarını öğrenir ve bir siber arkadaşı ona Yeni Nesil davasına ışık tutan bir video gönderir.

episodes.name: Embracement
episodes.description: Takumi grows dependent on Rimi’s calming presences as he struggles to discover the power of his own Di-Sword, and a cryptic phone call shakes the city to its core.

episodes.name: Realization
episodes.description: Takumi is rescued from a group of hired thugs by a classmate with telepathic abilities. After regaining consciousness, he learns the identity of the evil mastermind behind the earthquake.

episodes.name: Linkage
episodes.description: The Gigalomaniac Trio embarks on a daring mission to destroy Noah II, but their enemy remains a step ahead, ambushing the would-be heroes with their own worst nightmares.

episodes.name: Rejection
episodes.description: Yua goes to the police with information concerning Takumi, who receives a disturbing call for help from his little sister. Meanwhile, another New Gen incident occurs!

episodes.name: Purification
episodes.description: Takumi realizes the horrific truth about his troubled existence, Yua confronts the delusion of her dead sister, and Rimi attempts to rescue Nanami.

episodes.name: Independence
episodes.description: The General and Takumi meet face-to-face to discuss their shared existence. Later, after awakening his Di-Sword, Takumi goes underground for a showdown with an artificial gigalomaniac!

episodes.name: Mission
episodes.description: Takumi finally realizes his ultimate destiny: to destroy Noah II. But first, he must conquer the illusion of fear and defeat the one man standing in his way.
